page_title: MAR 2-2 NIC | Marseille v Nice 24/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' Crossbar! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
90+4' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
90+1' Here is a change. Geoffrey Kondogbia is going off and Jean-Louis Gasset gives the last tactical orders to Jean Onana (Marseille).
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) is coming onto the pitch as Jordan Veretout cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
90' Jeremie Boga (Nice) will take the corner.

90' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Khephren Thuram (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
86' Jeremie Boga (Nice) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
85' Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul after Pape Gueye (Marseille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
85' An attempted cross from Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is cleared.
82' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho will be replaced by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice).
81' What a wasted opportunity by Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Marcin Bulka makes a decent save to thwart him.
80' The substitution has been made. Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) has replaced Luis Henrique.
80' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
80' Jeremie Boga (Nice) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
79' Jeremie Boga (Nice) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.
78' Jeremie Boga (Nice) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him.

78' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Jeremie Boga (Nice) is going to have a crack himself.
76' Dante (Nice) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

72' 2 - 2 Melvin Bard (Nice) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2 with this magnificent strike.
65' The substitution is prepared. Pape Gueye (Marseille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amine Harit.
65' It's time for a substitution. Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) comes on in place of Antoine Mendy.
65' The game has come to an end for Morgan Sanson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
65' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to substitute Jonathan Clauss and he is replaced by Michael Murillo (Marseille).
64' A cross from Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
61' A yellow card for a tackle by Morgan Sanson (Nice). Jeremie Pignard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
57' Here's the change. Terem Moffi leaves the pitch and Evann Guessand (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
56' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Marcin Bulka no chance!
55' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
54' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Marseille!
54' Referee Jeremie Pignard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Marseille. Let’s see what happens!
54' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremie Pignard ignores the protests.
53' Jeremie Pignard blows the whistle, Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is penalised for a foul. PENALTY to Marseille! Let's see who will take responsibility.
53' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
52' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
52' Luis Henrique (Marseille) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
51' Melvin Bard (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Marseille.
50' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jeremie Boga (Nice) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
47' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Antoine Mendy (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+1' Rough tackle by Faris Moumbagna (Marseille). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Pau Lopez pulls off a great save to deny Morgan Sanson (Nice), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
42' A dangerous attempt from Morgan Sanson (Nice) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Pau Lopez pulls off a superb save and stops this one.
42' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille). Jeremie Pignard saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
41' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
38' Khephren Thuram (Nice) commits a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. Marseille earn a free kick.

36' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
35' Morgan Sanson (Nice) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Luis Henrique (Marseille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
33' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
31' 1 - 1 Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) makes a good run to meet a cross on the edge of the box and with a fantastic shot lashes the ball inside the right post.
31' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
30' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
29' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
28' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
24' Terem Moffi (Nice) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
23' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Luis Henrique (Marseille) heads on.
22' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jeremie Pignard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

19' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
13' 0 - 1 Terem Moffi (Nice) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
11' The foul by Terem Moffi (Nice) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jeremie Pignard.
10' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
9' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!

5' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremie Pignard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
3' Khephren Thuram (Nice) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Marseille will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jeremie Pignard.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
